Subject: Pilot timeline at risk — integration handshake failing

Hi Stephanie,

Quick update: our engineering team hit a blocker with the SSO + webhook handshake during environment parity testing. They've been debugging for two days and estimate another 2–3 weeks to complete the adapter work. The pilot was meant to start the week of Oct 18 — we may not hit that.

Request: could Redwood provide a 30-day trial extension and a small sandbox credit top-up (we're estimating ~15k extra tokens) so we can finish the integration and still run the pilot with customers?

I've attached the integration logs and our sprint plan for context.

Thanks,
Tom Blake
Head of Integrations
Handshake Health

Attachments: integration_logs.zip (log archive), handshake-sprint.pdf (sprint plan)

Hi Tom — thanks for the update and the attachments. Sorry to hear about the handshake instability.

Short answer: we can help. Immediate next steps I propose:
- Provide a 2-week sandbox credit boost (≈15k tokens) today so your engineers can finish debugging.
- Escalate internally for a 30–45 day trial extension depending on outcome — I will loop in finance/manager for approval.

Ben/Marissa — tagging you here to approve the additional credit and extension. If approved I will send an updated pilot amendment and attach a DocuSign link.

Marissa/Ben,

Forwarding handshake's note — their SSO/webhook handshake has regressed and they'll need ~3 weeks. They asked for a 30-day extension and ~15k tokens sandbox top-up to complete testing and run the pilot.

Why approve: high-strategic prospect, pilot already scheduled with two key customers, product fit validated (they're likely to convert if pilot runs). Risk of not approving: lost momentum and potential churn to competitor.

My recommendation:
- Immediate sandbox credit: 25,000 tokens (cover edge cases)
- Trial extension: 45 days to account for any follow-on debug
- Require a short post-pilot health check and a lock-in milestone (successful connector test) before converting to Paid

If you approve I'll prepare the amendment + DocuSign and notify CS to schedule a joint test session with their engineers.

Related records:
- Deal: DEAL-4892 (Handshake Health)
- HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/4892
- Attachments from customer: handshake-sprint.pdf, integration_logs.zip

Thanks — need a quick go/no-go to respond to Tom today.

-Steph
